scope: This checks the coefficient-classification core of Lemma 5.4. It does not prove the preceding square-product-to-scaling-symmetry implication or construct Kummer characters.
statement: For an odd-characteristic field, any nonzero nonidentity scaling symmetry of X^3 + A X + B forces B = 0 and r = -1 when A is nonzero, while for A = 0 and B nonzero it forces r^3 = 1.
